baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperfect يَخْشَىٰ inside the circumstantial وَهُوَ construction presents an ongoing inward state concurrent with the subject's action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reverent fear continuously orients the subject toward what exceeds him; the clause characterizes his manner of being, not merely a passing reaction.

activation_trace.role: Fear joined to reverent awe grounds a sustained inward orientation rather than a bare startle response.

changed_reading.after: He is acting while held in an ongoing posture of reverent fear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb alone can carry a figurative relation between خشية and knowing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fear is generated by apprehension: the subject is not merely agitated but responsive to something inwardly recognized as weighty and real.

activation_trace.role: The figurative knowing branch makes cognition a live interior component of the fear.

changed_reading.before: He feels fear without any stated cognitive content.
changed_reading.after: His fear is an apprehensive knowing, an inward recognition that already bears on conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root's materially distant dryness branch remains attached to يَخْشَىٰ even though it is not the ordinary rendering of the form.
baseline_models.mechanism: Awe can be imaged somatically as contraction, loss of ease, or drying under pressure; this supplies a material analogue for vulnerability without replacing the fear sense.

activation_trace.role: Shriveling and dryness supply an exploratory bodily image for inward contraction under awe.

changed_reading.before: Fear is only an invisible emotion.
changed_reading.after: Fear can also be carried as a contracted, depleted bodily condition that may prove either fragile or receptive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival and purposeful striving prevent خشية from being read as paralysis. The later path and ease images extend the same vector: awe accompanies an approach and can organize motion toward a sought end.

activation_trace.role: Reverent fear supplies the inward force whose relation to movement is being revised.
Actual arrival establishes that the fearful subject has crossed distance rather than withdrawn.
Purposeful motion toward a goal gives the approach intention and direction.
The extended traversable path turns the earlier approach into part of a larger directional pattern.
Light, compliant movement shows that directed motion may be enabled rather than impeded.

structural_cues: 80:9 is a circumstantial clause attached to the singular seeker who arrives striving in 80:8, while 80:20 later resumes the vocabulary of directed passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, purposeful striving, awe, a path, and facilitated motion; I infer that awe helps orient the motion, while the live alternative is that fear merely coexists with an independently motivated approach.

changed_reading.after: He approaches in and through reverent fear; the fear is compatible with, and may supply direction to, purposeful movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene opposes visible facial management and allocated attention to an unseen inward quality. Physical blindness does not make the seeker's condition illegible: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ supplies the decisive evidence that the outward attention economy missed.

activation_trace.role: Reverent awe is the hidden positive condition against which outward attention is re-ranked.
A visible facial contraction supplies the scene's first outward social signal.
Turning away converts the facial signal into an allocation of bodily attention.
Loss of physical sight creates the outwardly disadvantaged position whose inner state must be recognized otherwise.
Deliberately facing toward something makes attention an active, selective act.
Being occupied away from one thing by another names the cost of the mistaken selection.

structural_cues: Across 80:1-10, outward acts of facing and turning surround the only explicit report of the seeker's inward condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible expression, turning, blindness, selective facing, distraction, and hidden awe; I infer that the hidden awe is corrective evidence for allocating attention, while the alternative is a narrower rebuke about manners without a general criterion of receptivity.

changed_reading.before: The clause adds a private devotional detail about the visitor.
changed_reading.after: The clause reveals the visitor's otherwise invisible eligibility for attention and overturns a ranking based on visible access, status, or convenience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence from not knowing another's possibility, through purification and recollection, to benefit makes the focus fear an epistemic readiness. Apprehensive knowing is valuable because it can receive a reminder and undergo change.

activation_trace.role: Figurative knowing provides the focus state that can be developed by instruction.
Explicit knowledge marks the observer's uncertainty about the seeker's latent possibility.
Purity and rectification supply the possible transformation opened by receptivity.
Recovering what was forgotten turns instruction into active interior recollection.
Benefit supplies the realized effect by which receptivity becomes consequential.

structural_cues: The possibility chain in 80:3-4 precedes the factual circumstantial description in 80:9, so the latter can disclose the latent condition the earlier questions could not see.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertainty, possible purification, recollection, benefit, and knowing within خشية; I infer a movement from receptive apprehension to transformation, while purification and recollection may instead be parallel possibilities rather than a fixed causal chain.

changed_reading.before: He already possesses a settled state of fear.
changed_reading.after: His apprehensive knowing is a teachable threshold from which reminder, recollection, benefit, and purification can unfold.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder, written surface, disclosure, and truth carried into deed form a transmission chain opposed to covering truth. The knowing aspect of خشية places the seeker on the receptive side of that chain before its media and agents are named.

activation_trace.role: Apprehensive knowing supplies an interior receiving state for the reminder.
A reminder that actively prompts recollection identifies what the receptive state can take up.
The written sheet supplies a durable surface in the transmission mechanism.
A book that discloses what is written makes transmission simultaneously preservation and unveiling.
Truth that passes through speech into action supplies the enacted terminus of reception.
Blocking or covering truth provides the inverse failure mode of the same communication chain.

structural_cues: The focus clause is followed immediately by the correction and the reminder complex of 80:11-16, then by the covering accusation of 80:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apprehensive knowing, reminder, inscription, disclosure, enacted truth, and concealment; I infer a receiver-to-transmission pathway, while the live alternative is that the media description concerns only the reminder's dignity and not the seeker's cognition.

changed_reading.before: He fears in response to a message.
changed_reading.after: His fear marks an already receptive knowing through which a reminder can be disclosed, retained, and carried into action rather than covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure, traversable path, death, revival, and completion form a temporal itinerary. The knowing branch of خشية can therefore be read as compressed awareness of an entire trajectory, not alarm confined to a present stimulus.

activation_trace.role: Apprehensive knowing allows the focus state to hold a future sequence in the present.
Deliberate ordering and measure establish that the life sequence has articulated stages.
A path extended for traversal converts measured existence into directed passage.
Loss of life and power supplies the apparent terminal boundary of the path.
Revival after death reopens the trajectory beyond its apparent boundary.
Completion and finishing make non-fulfillment measurable against an intended end.

structural_cues: The repeated ثُمَّ sequence in 80:19-23 orders creation, passage, death, burial, revival, and unfinished obligation into a temporal chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered life sequence and the knowing possibility within خشية; I infer that the seeker's present awe apprehends this larger trajectory, while the alternative is that his fear has unspecified content and the later sequence independently supplies admonition.

changed_reading.before: He fears an unstated object in the immediate encounter.
changed_reading.after: He carries present awareness of a measured path whose apparent end in death opens again toward revival and completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's shriveled dryness enters an ecological sequence in which dry herbage is revived, water is delivered, closed ground is opened, and growth emerges, including the palm implicated by the focus branch's scope. Contraction under awe becomes a potentially water-receptive condition rather than a terminal deficit.

activation_trace.role: The dryness branch gives the fearful state a shriveled material analogue whose fate can be retested by the later ecology.
Dry herbage revived by rain explicitly makes dryness reversible within the packet's image field.
Copious pouring supplies the force that reaches and saturates what was dry.
Water delivered through irrigation specifies the restorative medium rather than a merely abstract blessing.
Cracking open a closed surface provides the transition from saturation to emergence.
Growth issuing from the earth supplies the visible reversal of shriveling.
The palm makes the ecological cycle touch the plant domain carried in the focus dryness branch's scope.

structural_cues: Revival in 80:22 is followed by the tightly causal water, opened-earth, and growth sequence of 80:25-31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus dryness image and a later material cycle that reverses dryness; I infer that fearful contraction may describe receptivity to renewal, while the strong alternative is accidental branch coexistence with no semantic transfer to the person.

changed_reading.before: The dryness image makes fear look like depletion alone.
changed_reading.after: The seeker's contracted state may be like dry growth poised for watering and reopening, so vulnerability can be the condition of renewal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with a managed facial contraction, inserts the seeker's invisible awe, and ends with faces on which disclosure, joy, dust, constriction, and covering become legible. The focus clause is a hidden-state report placed between present misreading of a face and eventual exteriorization of inner conditions.

activation_trace.role: Reverent awe supplies the inward condition that is known narratively before it is visible socially.
Facial contraction opens the question of what a visible expression does and does not disclose.
A face brightening into disclosure supplies one terminal mode of inward state becoming surface.
Joy or wonder visibly expressed in laughter intensifies the exteriorization.
News that opens the skin with gladness links received knowledge to a changed face.
Dust and earth-color supply the contrary surface on which distress settles visibly.
An overpowering cover makes the negative facial state something imposed and engulfing.
Constriction and reduction give the darkened surface an inward pressure.
Covering names the terminal negative category and binds epistemic concealment to the covered face.

structural_cues: A face-expression opens 80:1, an inward circumstantial clause identifies the seeker in 80:9, and repeated faces dominate 80:38-42.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening face, hidden awe, and final faces that disclose opposed conditions; I infer a delayed interior-to-surface pattern, while the alternative is only compositional framing without any specific projection from the seeker to a final face.

changed_reading.before: The seeker's fear is private and has no relation to the surah's facial imagery.
changed_reading.after: The clause records an inward truth that present observers cannot read from surfaces, within a surah where inward conditions eventually become facially legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fearful seeker approaches as a singular person without the shelter of status, while the final scene strips every person from sibling, spouse, and descendants and gives each a self-sufficiently absorbing concern. His awe can be read as voluntary de-centering before universal forced isolation.

activation_trace.role: Reverent awe supplies the inward relinquishment that can be contrasted with claims of self-sufficiency and later isolation.
Claimed independence supplies the social posture opposed to vulnerable approach.
Flight turns ordinary relational proximity into forced separation.
The binding tie of kinship makes the later flight a rupture of genuine support.
Close companionship supplies another ordinarily durable relation that cannot absorb the final concern.
Filial descent and origin extend the severed network across generations.
A concern sufficient to occupy each person reverses the earlier posture of socially impressive independence.

structural_cues: The singular seeker of 80:8-9 is set against the relational inventory and repeated individualization of 80:34-37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vulnerable singular approach, claimed independence, severed bonds, and individually absorbing concern; I infer that awe rehearses a willing release of false supports, while the alternative is that the two scenes share only singular grammar and no developmental relation.

changed_reading.before: He is simply one anxious visitor among other social actors.
changed_reading.after: His awe may mark an early, voluntary standing-alone before truth, contrasted with both claimed self-sufficiency now and unavoidable isolation later.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it locates operative knowing in the physically blind visitor and redirects the demand for sight toward the observer. It remains anchored in the focus knowing branch and the packet's explicit sight and knowledge roots; render it as an epistemic reversal, not as a claim that physical blindness inherently grants insight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The figurative knowing branch of يَخْشَىٰ permits the physically blind subject to be characterized by apprehension rather than lack of cognition.

activation_trace.role: Apprehensive knowing supplies cognition precisely where the scene foregrounds absent eyesight.
Physical loss of sight establishes the bodily limitation without deciding the person's inward perception.
Knowledge names the very faculty the observer lacks concerning the visitor's possibility.
Directed sight or insight later becomes an imperative task rather than an automatic possession of the sighted.

changed_reading.before: The blind man is devout despite an epistemic disability.
changed_reading.after: The physically blind visitor already bears apprehensive knowing, while the sighted observer is the one whose perception must be corrected and redirected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped inventory for ع م ي, where a visibly appearing person coexists with the blindness cue. It remains valid as a supplied split-root provocation anchored by the seeker's awe and purposeful approach; render it as a visibility paradox, never as an etymological equation between blindness and appearing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The seeker's وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ gives him ethical salience even when the encounter treats him as easy to turn away from.

activation_trace.role: Reverent awe supplies the hidden quality that makes the marginalized visitor ethically prominent.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes the image of a person visibly standing forth, reversing social invisibility.
Purposeful approach makes the supposedly peripheral figure actively present in the encounter.

changed_reading.before: The blind visitor remains a marginal figure whose inner fear is noted privately.
changed_reading.after: His purposeful awe makes him the person who most decisively stands forth in ethical view, despite being physically blind and socially overlooked.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the focus root's dryness branch across an opening dry residue and final dusty constriction. It remains anchored in the focus branch and is differentiated by the seeker's actual movement; downstream prose should call it a material analogy, not a lexical translation or a fixed moral code for dryness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dryness branch of يَخْشَىٰ allows the seeker's awe to be imaged as contraction while the verse still explicitly locates him in active approach.

activation_trace.role: Shriveling supplies the focus-side material contraction whose moral valence remains undecided.
A dry residue on an exterior surface links the opening contraction to material desiccation.
Purposeful movement distinguishes the seeker's contraction from inert or terminal encrustation.
Dust settling into earth-color supplies a terminal-looking outer layer.
Constriction and reduction intensify the opposed image of a closing, covered surface.

changed_reading.before: Material contraction is uniformly negative depletion.
changed_reading.after: The seeker's dryness-like contraction remains mobile and responsive, unlike the final encrusted surfaces; similar material pressure can conceal opposite trajectories.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the echo branch behind the attending verb in 80:6. It remains anchored by contrast with the focus subject's apprehensive knowing and by the surrounding self-sufficiency and distraction cues; render it as an attention-economy metaphor, not as the direct lexical sense of تَصَدَّىٰ in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus knowing branch makes the fearful seeker a source of disconfirming information rather than a mere object competing for attention.

activation_trace.role: Apprehensive knowing makes the seeker carry information that the current attention pattern has not registered.
Displayed independence supplies the prestigious signal toward which attention is drawn.
A returning echo images attention that receives back its own projection instead of new evidence.
Occupation by one object explains how the quieter, information-bearing seeker is missed.

changed_reading.before: The fearful seeker simply loses a competition for attention.
changed_reading.after: Attention to apparent self-sufficiency may return an echo of prior expectations, while the fearful seeker brings the new inward evidence capable of correcting them.

strongest_changes: Fear changed from possible paralysis into purposeful, path-shaped movement.
The hidden clause became corrective evidence that re-ranks visible status and directs attention toward receptivity.
The knowing branch connected awe to purification, recollection, transmission, and awareness of the full life trajectory.
The dryness branch remained live as a reversible ecological condition and as a contrast between responsive contraction and terminal covering.
Opening and final face imagery made the focus clause an inward truth situated between present surface-misreading and later exterior disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: A three-word circumstantial clause supported coexisting affective, kinetic, epistemic, social, temporal, facial, and ecological readings. The most distinctive activations came from refusing to discard the focus root's dryness branch and the non-dominant visibility branch supplied for the blindness cue.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports coexistence between awe and purposeful movement, but does not settle whether awe causes the movement or only accompanies it.
The receiver-to-transmission and life-trajectory readings infer directional relations across later sequences rather than receiving those arrows explicitly.
The dryness and split-root visibility models are deliberately branch-distant and should remain exploratory material analogies, not lexical claims.
The final-face pattern does not identify the seeker with a particular final face; it only changes how hidden interiority is read within the surah's framing.
